clauses.quote: This scheme is not considered to be a secure method of user authentication unless used in conjunction with some external secure system such as TLS (Transport Layer Security, [RFC5246]), as the user-id and password are passed over the network as cleartext.
clauses.gateway: 背景：Basic 凭据只是 Base64，等于明文。客户端到入口、网关到上游这两段如果不在 TLS 里，凭据（包括用户名里的会话参数）对链路上的人可见。

clauses.quote: The authentication parameter 'realm' is REQUIRED ([RFC7235], Section 2.2).
clauses.gateway: 约束的是发质询的一方。入口发 407 时，Proxy-Authenticate: Basic 必须带 realm 参数。

clauses.quote: The authentication parameter 'charset' is OPTIONAL (see Section 2.1).
clauses.gateway: 入口的质询可以带也可以不带 charset；带与不带时客户端发来的字节有没有差别，由矩阵测。

clauses.quote: No other authentication parameters are defined -- unknown parameters MUST be ignored by recipients, and new parameters can only be defined by revising this specification.
clauses.gateway: 约束的是收质询的一方。上游一侧：网关解析上游的 Basic 质询时，不认识的参数必须忽略，不能因此判质询无效。入口：不要指望靠自造的质询参数向客户端传信息，合规的客户端会忽略它们。

clauses.quote: Note that both scheme and parameter names are matched case- insensitively.
clauses.gateway: 方案名和参数名不分大小写。入口解析 Proxy-Authorization 时 basic、BASIC 都要认；上游一侧解析质询时 Basic、realm、charset 的大小写都不能写死。

clauses.quote: A proxy can respond with a similar challenge using the 407 (Proxy Authentication Required) status code ([RFC7235], Section 3.2) and the Proxy-Authenticate header field ([RFC7235], Section 4.3).
clauses.gateway: Basic 用在代理上时，质询的形式是 407 加 Proxy-Authenticate。原文是 can，只说明形式，承接的上一句讲的是没带凭据的请求。凭据不对时回什么、CONNECT 是否同样处理，本条没有规定，依据在 RFC 9110（9110-11.7.1-1、9110-15.5.8-1）。

clauses.quote: To receive authorization, the client 1. obtains the user-id and password from the user, 2. constructs the user-pass by concatenating the user-id, a single colon (":") character, and the password, 3. encodes the user-pass into an octet sequence (see below for a discussion of character encoding schemes), 4. and obtains the basic-credentials by encoding this octet sequence using Base64 ([RFC4648], Section 4) into a sequence of US-ASCII characters ([RFC0020]).
clauses.gateway: 凭据的构造：user-id、一个冒号、password 拼成 user-pass，编码成字节，再做 Base64。入口反过来做：Base64 解码，按第一个冒号拆开；上游一侧网关按这四步生成。解码之后是字节序列，用的是哪种字符编码凭据本身不带。

clauses.quote: For backwards compatibility reasons, this specification continues to leave the default encoding undefined, as long as it is compatible with US-ASCII (mapping any US-ASCII character to a single octet matching the US-ASCII character code).
clauses.gateway: 默认的字符编码没有定义，只保证与 US-ASCII 兼容。入口的会话参数语法只用 US-ASCII 字符，才不受客户端编码差异的影响；非 ASCII 的用户名到达时可能是 UTF-8，也可能是别的编码。

clauses.quote: The user-id and password MUST NOT contain any control characters (see "CTL" in Appendix B.1 of [RFC5234]).
clauses.gateway: 约束的是凭据的内容，也就是生成它的一方。上游一侧：配置里的上游凭据含控制字符时不能发出。入口：解出来的用户名或密码含控制字符就是不合规的凭据；条款没有规定接收方必须怎么处理，入口拒绝它不违反条款。会话参数的语法不能用控制字符。

clauses.quote: Furthermore, a user-id containing a colon character is invalid, as the first colon in a user-pass string separates user-id and password from one another; text after the first colon is part of the password. User-ids containing colons cannot be encoded in user-pass strings.
clauses.gateway: 入口按第一个冒号拆：前面是用户名，后面全部是密码，所以密码可以含冒号，用户名不能。放在用户名里的会话参数因此不能用冒号做分隔符。上游一侧：上游凭据的用户名含冒号时无法用 Basic 表达，应在配置时报错。

clauses.quote: Note that many user agents produce user-pass strings without checking that user-ids supplied by users do not contain colons; recipients will then treat part of the username input as part of the password.
clauses.gateway: 背景：很多客户端不检查用户名里的冒号，原样拼接；入口按第一个冒号拆出来的用户名会被截短，后半段进了密码。哪些客户端这样做由矩阵测。

clauses.quote: In challenges, servers can use the 'charset' authentication parameter to indicate the character encoding scheme they expect the user agent to use when generating "user-pass" (a sequence of octets). This information is purely advisory.
clauses.gateway: 原文写的是 servers，这里指发质询的一方，入口发 407 时也适用（2.1 节末尾有 Proxy-Authorization 的例子）。charset 只是建议（purely advisory）：入口即使发了 charset="UTF-8"，也不能假定收到的凭据一定是 UTF-8。

clauses.quote: The only allowed value is "UTF-8"; it is to be matched case- insensitively (see [RFC2978], Section 2.3). It indicates that the server expects character data to be converted to Unicode Normalization Form C ("NFC"; see Section 3 of [RFC5198]) and to be encoded into octets using the UTF-8 character encoding scheme ([RFC3629]).
clauses.gateway: charset 只有 UTF-8 这一个取值，不分大小写。入口要发就只能发这个值。上游一侧解析上游的质询时，看到 charset=UTF-8（任意大小写）就把上游凭据按 NFC 规范化后用 UTF-8 编码：这是按参数的含义做的设计选择，原文在这一节说这个参数只是建议性的（purely advisory），没有要求客户端照做。

clauses.quote: For the user-id, recipients MUST support all characters defined in the "UsernameCasePreserved" profile defined in Section 3.3 of [RFC7613], with the exception of the colon (":") character. For the password, recipients MUST support all characters defined in the "OpaqueString" profile defined in Section 4.2 of [RFC7613].
clauses.gateway: 这两句在讲 charset="UTF-8" 的段落里。recipients 指谁原文没有明说，有两种读法：收凭据的一方（入口在质询里发了 charset="UTF-8"，就得能处理这两个 profile 里的全部字符，不能只收 ASCII）；或者收到 charset 参数的一方（那样上游一侧的网关也受约束）。side 按前一种读法填的入口。两个 profile 的内容在 RFC 7613 里，不在本次核对的文本之内：未验证。

clauses.quote: Note: The 'charset' is only defined on challenges, as Basic authentication uses a single token for credentials ('token68' syntax); thus, the credentials syntax isn't extensible.
clauses.gateway: charset 只出现在质询里，凭据里没有地方声明编码。入口无法从 Proxy-Authorization 得知客户端用了什么编码，只能按字节处理。

clauses.quote: Or, for proxy authentication: Proxy-Authorization: Basic dGVzdDoxMjPCow==
clauses.gateway: 背景：原文的例子。用于代理认证时凭据的构造完全一样，只是放在 Proxy-Authorization 头里。

clauses.quote: A client MAY preemptively send the corresponding Authorization header field with requests for resources in that space without receipt of another challenge from the server. Similarly, when a client sends a request to a proxy, it MAY reuse a user-id and password in the Proxy- Authorization header field without receiving another challenge from the proxy server.
clauses.gateway: 讲的是重用：客户端用过一组凭据之后，后续发给代理的请求可以直接带上它，不必等代理再发一次质询（MAY，约束客户端）。入口因此会看到没有先经 407 就带凭据的请求，这是合规的；上游一侧，网关对同一个上游代理的后续请求也可以这样重用。从未收到过质询的第一个请求带不带凭据（矩阵 R30、R31、R52、R53 量的情形），这两句没有规定；RFC 9110 的相关说法见 9110-11.3-3。

clauses.quote: User-ids or passwords containing characters outside the US-ASCII character repertoire will cause interoperability issues, unless both communication partners agree on what character encoding scheme is to be used.
clauses.gateway: 背景：非 ASCII 的用户名或密码在双方没有约定编码时会出互通问题。会话参数和网关签发的凭据都限定在 US-ASCII 之内可以避开。

clauses.quote: The most serious flaw of Basic authentication is that it results in the cleartext transmission of the user's password over the physical network.
clauses.gateway: 背景：Basic 的密码在网络上是明文。

clauses.quote: Because Basic authentication involves the cleartext transmission of passwords, it SHOULD NOT be used (without enhancements such as HTTPS [RFC2818]) to protect sensitive or valuable information.
clauses.gateway: 没有 TLS 之类的保护时，不应当用 Basic 保护敏感或有价值的信息。入口在明文端口上收 Basic、网关向明文的上游代理发 Basic 都属于这种情形；这是 SHOULD NOT，要么给这两段加 TLS，要么在文档里写明凭据在链路上可见。

clauses.quote: Servers and proxies implementing Basic authentication need to store user passwords in some form in order to authenticate a request. These passwords ought to be stored in such a way that a leak of the password data doesn't make them trivially recoverable.
clauses.gateway: 入口用来核对客户端密码的数据，存放方式应当做到泄露之后不能轻易还原出密码（ought to，不是规范性关键词）。这句管的是入口核对别人密码的数据，不涉及网关为了向上游认证而必须持有的上游凭据。

clauses.quote: Other user agents can keep their default behavior and switch to UTF-8 when seeing the new parameter.
clauses.gateway: 背景：客户端可以平时用自己的默认编码，看到 charset 参数再改用 UTF-8。所以同一个客户端在质询带不带 charset 时发来的字节可能不同。

clauses.quote: Clients that do understand the 'charset' parameter will then start to use UTF-8, while other clients will continue to send credentials in their default encoding, broken credentials, or no credentials at all. Until all clients are upgraded to support UTF-8, servers are likely to see both UTF-8 and "legacy" encodings in requests.
clauses.gateway: 背景：发了 charset 之后，入口仍然会同时看到 UTF-8 和旧编码的凭据，还有坏掉的凭据或者干脆不带凭据的请求。
